summary: RouteChromeData is now a discriminated union so a tabBar:true/topNav:true route without navLabel fails to compile (ADR-0042 §7). nav-tabs.ts collect() walks the route tree once, emitting one NavTab per route with tabBar/topNav set, reading link/roles/labelKey off that same object -- NAV_TABS (hand-written), rolesForLink() and chromeDataByPath are deleted. tab-bar.ts and screen-header.ts (out-of-scope but forced) filter on tab.roles directly. The fail-open was reproduced pre-fix before landing the fix; nav-tabs.spec.ts now asserts a guest sees none of milestones/guests/seating/config.

acceptance.criterion: RouteChromeData gains navLabel and becomes a discriminated union so a tabBar:true or topNav:true route cannot compile without one
acceptance.evidence: src/app/core/guard/route-chrome-data.ts: RouteChromeData = NonNavRouteChromeData | NavRouteChromeData; NavRouteChromeData requires navLabel: string, NonNavRouteChromeData forbids it (navLabel?: never) and requires tabBar/topNav absent-or-false. Reproduced the compile failure with a scratch file: `const bad = { id: 'x', tabBar: true } satisfies RouteChromeData;` -> `tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit` -> "error TS1360: ... Property 'navLabel' is missing in type '{ id: string; tabBar: true; }' but required in type 'NavRouteChromeData'." Scratch file removed after the repro; not part of the diff.

acceptance.criterion: nav-tabs.ts keeps a collect() walk emitting one NavTab per route whose data sets tabBar or topNav, composing link from the route tree and carrying roles on the tab itself
acceptance.evidence: src/app/shared/nav-tabs.ts:44-58 collect(list: Route[]): NavTab[] -- pushes { id: data.id, labelKey: data.navLabel, link: `/${route.path}`, roles: data.roles } when route.path is defined, data.navLabel is defined, and (data.tabBar || data.topNav). NavTab (line 7-13) gains `roles?: UserRole[]`.

acceptance.criterion: NAV_TABS (the hand-written array), rolesForLink() and chromeDataByPath are deleted
acceptance.evidence: `grep -rn 'rolesForLink|chromeDataByPath' src/app --include=*.ts --include=*.html` returns no matches (only a doc-comment mention of the retired rolesForLink() inside nav-tabs.ts's own header comment, describing the old defect). The hand-written 11-entry array literal is gone; NAV_TABS is now `export const NAV_TABS: NavTab[] = collect(routes).sort(...)`.

acceptance.criterion: tab-bar.ts filters on tab.roles directly; overflows/primaryTabs/restTabs and the More sheet are untouched, because NavTab keeps its shape
acceptance.evidence: src/app/shared/tab-bar/tab-bar.ts visibleTabs computed: `NAV_TABS.filter((tab) => (!tab.roles || tab.roles.includes(this.login.role())) && this.routeConfig.isRouteEnabled(tab.link))`. `git diff --stat src/app/shared/tab-bar/tab-bar.ts` -> only the import line and the visibleTabs body changed (13 lines); overflows/primaryTabs/restTabs/toggleSheet/closeSheet and tab-bar.html are untouched.

acceptance.criterion: Order stays an explicit constant -- a route cannot know it is third -- but shrinks to a list of ids
acceptance.evidence: src/app/shared/nav-tabs.ts:17-30 `const NAV_ORDER: readonly string[] = ['home','rsvp','schedule','album','travel','people','guests','seating','milestones','config'];`, used as `collect(routes).sort((a, b) => NAV_ORDER.indexOf(a.id) - NAV_ORDER.indexOf(b.id))`. Replaces the previous 11 hand-written NavTab object literals.

acceptance.criterion: A test asserts the guest role sees no milestones, guests, seating or config entry; must fail against the current code
acceptance.evidence: Pre-fix repro (nav-tabs.ts untouched): a throwaway spec called the real exported `rolesForLink('/prep-timeline')` (a plausible renamed path with no entry in the pre-fix chromeDataByPath map) and asserted `expect(roles).toBeDefined()` -- `npx ng test --include='src/app/shared/nav-tabs.spec.ts' --watch=false` -> '1 failed', 'AssertionError: expected undefined to be defined', proving the fail-open (undefined reads as "no restriction" at tab-bar.ts:44) is live in the pre-fix mechanism. That throwaway file was then replaced by the committed src/app/shared/nav-tabs.spec.ts, which post-fix asserts `visibleTo('guest')` contains none of ['milestones','guests','seating','config'] against the real production route tree -- `npx ng test --include='src/app/shared/nav-tabs.spec.ts' --watch=false` -> '5 passed'.

acceptance.criterion: Both home entries (/me, /dashboard) still resolve, and role filtering still renders exactly one
acceptance.evidence: src/app/shared/nav-tabs.spec.ts: 'both `home` routes (/me, /dashboard) resolve into NAV_TABS' asserts NAV_TABS.filter(id==='home').link sorted === ['/dashboard','/me']; 'role filtering renders exactly one `home` entry for a guest' asserts length 1, link '/me'; the couple-equivalent asserts length 1, link '/dashboard'. All pass.
